dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit jagged, high-contrast dark perimeters on the mid-dorsal surface. The transition from the dark exterior boundaries to the lighter interior is characterized by a rapid pixel intensity increase across a narrow spatial gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of small, high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated primarily in the anterior ventral region and scattered along the lower lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A central group of four macro-annuli centroids forms an irregular quadrilateral in the mid-dorsal region. An obtuse triangle is formed by connecting the centroids of the anterior-most macro-annulus with two localized high-intensity blobs on the lower lateral flank.
